name: Improve Dubroff-Fox-Xu subset sum lower bound

insights: DFX uses variance of random subset sum: Var = sum(a_i^2)/4
Berry-Esseen anticoncentration bounds number of distinct values by range/stddev
The improvement over counting is by factor sqrt(n), asymptotically
Key algebraic bounds: sum(a_i^2) <= n*N^2 and sum(a_i) <= n*N are straightforward
Cauchy-Schwarz for sums (sum(a_i))^2 <= n*sum(a_i^2) needs careful induction
The assembly step combining anticoncentration with variance bounds needs real analysis
knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Algebraic framework built (variance bounds proved). Anticoncentration axiomatized. Assembly and Cauchy-Schwarz have sorries.
nextSteps: Prove Cauchy-Schwarz for finite sums (induction on Finset)
Prove dfx_lower_bound from anticoncentration + variance bounds
Build probability infrastructure in Mathlib to eliminate anticoncentration axiom
